Pressing the button opened a dark blue page: 'Power up your learning with unlimited energy on Super!' with a large infinity-battery picture and a 'START MY FREE WEEK' button, which I did not press. I closed it with the X. When I came back, the Shop's box had changed its own words to 'Features for faster learning. Get unlimited energy and say goodbye to ads.' On the Energy page, the 'Unlimited ... FREE TRIAL' row opened exactly the same dark blue page, with the same words, picture and button. Once I saw that page I could recognise it as the same offer, and the infinity-battery picture on the row matches it. But the Shop's own box first talked about a family plan, which that page never mentions, so I only knew it was the same offer after opening both.

cfg5.same_expectation_why: 'Widget Reward' with 'GET STARTED' and 'Widget Boost' with 'INSTALL' both involve a widget, but 'reward' and 'boost', and 'get started' and 'install', are different words, so they may or may not be the same thing.
cfg5.affects_navigation: Yes: I would wonder whether I had already done this from the other screen, or whether there are two separate widget things to do.

first_pass.why: The two cards describe what might be one job with different names, different button words and different pictures. I would read both over and over trying to decide whether they are the same, and I could not commit.
first_pass.solution: Give the same job the same name and button word in both places, for example 'Add widget' on both.

test_cases.what_to_try: In the Shop press 'Widget Reward ... GET STARTED', read it and press MAYBE LATER; then on the lightning-bolt page press 'Widget Boost ... INSTALL', read it and press NOT NOW.
test_cases.real_if: I can't tell whether they're the same job.
test_cases.what_happened: 'GET STARTED' in the Shop opened a page: 'Add the Duolingo widget to your home screen to earn an XP Boost.', with ADD NOW and MAYBE LATER. I pressed MAYBE LATER. 'INSTALL' on the Energy page opened a different page: 'Add the widget to get +8 energy every hour!', with ADD WIDGET and NOT NOW. I pressed NOT NOW. Both ask me to add a widget, so the action is the same, but they promise different rewards, an XP Boost on one and energy every hour on the other, with different pictures and different button words. I still cannot tell whether this is one widget that gives both, or two different widgets.
